```artifact
Feature: Doctor Consultation and Prescription Management

  Scenario: Doctor views pending appointments
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor views the pending appointments list
    Then the doctor should see a list of pending consultation requests

  Scenario: Doctor provides consultation and generates prescription
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request
    When the doctor provides consultation and generates a prescription
    Then the doctor should see a confirmation message
    And the prescription should be generated and saved

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes lab tests
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request
    When the doctor prescribes lab tests
    Then the lab tests should be added to the consultation request
    And the doctor should see a confirmation message

  Scenario: Lab test is created and requested
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a consultation request with lab tests
    When the lab tests are requested
    Then the lab test requests should be sent to the lab
    And the doctor should see a confirmation message

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes medicines
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request
    When the doctor prescribes medicines
    Then the medicines should be added to the consultation request
    And the doctor should see a confirmation message

  Scenario: Medicines are requested for delivery
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a consultation request with medicines
    When the medicines are requested for delivery
    Then the medicines should be requested to the concerned Chemist for delivery
    And the doctor should see a confirmation message

  Scenario: Lab tests are performed and reports are updated
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a consultation request with lab tests
    When the lab tests are performed and reports are received
    Then the reports should be updated in the consultation request
    And the doctor should see a confirmation message

  Scenario: Lab report is released for viewing
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a consultation request with lab reports
    When the doctor views the lab reports
    Then the lab reports should be released for viewing
    And the doctor should see the lab reports
```
